reviews.author: Ajith
reviews.text:
Title: Pleasant Ambience and Cleanliness, but Mediocre Mutton Biryani

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐

Tables were spotless, and the restroom facilities were well-maintained, which is always a big plus.

However, I have to admit that I was a bit disappointed with the food, particularly the mutton biryani. Despite the promising start, the biryani fell short of expectations. The rice was fragrant and cooked to perfection, but the meat left much to be desired. The mutton in the biryani was not properly cooked – it was tough and lacked the tenderness and flavor that one would expect in a biryani dish. This was a letdown, as the quality of meat is crucial in making a biryani exceptional.

While the rest of the dishes we ordered were decent, the mutton biryani's quality was a significant drawback for me. I believe that improving the preparation of the meat in this dish could make a substantial difference in the overall dining experience.

reviews.author: Venod V
reviews.text:
The food Veg and Non Veg was good.
The Steward Mr. Dinesh was very humble and provided excellent service.
The ambience was also good.
Only observation was the poor maintenance of hand wash area and the washroom. If a little bit of extra care on the higiene will make the place worth for families to spend some good time 💕

reviews.author: Vimal Kumar
reviews.text:
Ambience is beautiful, service is excellent, food is very good...
Special thanks and wonderful service by Aman, Kripan and Rohit... A place that can be visited family and friends, they understood what customers service means for us, they cared for us and this means I will keep coming with my corporate friends and family. This place should feel proud of having such people to serve n take care of people so that they keep coming each time

We all liked the washroom hygeine and this is kudos to Management
